tool: gpt-image-2 through tools/buildings/concept.sh, prompt from tools/icons/icons.py
prompt:
Use case: one game icon for Under the Canopy, a Warcraft III: Reforged-like RTS of insect armies on the forest floor. The game shows it small (about 56 to 72 pixels) on its HUD command card, so it must read instantly at that size.
THE ICON FAMILY (every icon in the game follows it): a square, full-bleed, hand-painted stylised 3D illustration in the manner of Warcraft III: Reforged unit and ability icons. ONE subject, big in the frame, with chunky, simple, bold forms, crisp clean edges, glossy materials with clear edge highlights, saturated but controlled colour. Strong value contrast: the subject is clearly brighter and more saturated than its background, and a bright rim light separates its silhouette. Light: a warm key light from the upper left and a cool blue-violet rim light from behind on the right. The background is dark, simple and soft, never scenery: a smoky vignette that falls to near-black in the corners. Keep the bottom-right corner calm and dark (the game draws a hotkey letter there). NO text, letters, numbers, runes, UI, frame, border or bevel (the game draws the frame). No noise, grain, sparkle, specks or tiny clutter; few, large, clear shapes.
ICON TYPE: ABILITY (an active spell or skill). It shows the ACTION at its peak moment, not a portrait: a dynamic, diagonal composition with motion and energy, the caster's weapon or body part as the subject when it helps. The ability's energy colour lights the scene and glows behind the subject: abilities are the brightest icons in the game, but the corners still fall to darkness.
FACTION: BEETLES, a fortress race of steam and contained magic. Their bodies are plain glossy black chitin, never glowing and never mutated. Materials: dark riveted steel, brass, and royal-blue painted plates (the faction's colour, large clean solid areas). Substance, the forest's magic, glows deep blue to violet ONLY inside glass (tanks, coils, canisters, lanterns, gauges): never green, never yellow, never on a body. Match the reference images' materials and palette exactly.
REFERENCES: the first image is the subject's approved concept: keep its design, materials and colours exactly. The other images are approved icons of the same family: match their rendering, lighting, background and framing, but not their subject.
THE SUBJECT: STATIC FIELD, the Arcwright charges the ground: seen from slightly above, the coiled brass tip of the Arcwright's coil lance (upper left) is driven down into dark earth, and a wide flat disc of crackling violet static lightning spreads across the ground from it in a circle, short arcs leaping up out of the ground and snapping around the thin legs of a dark enemy insect caught inside the circle. Energy colour: violet and electric white.
